p:cNvPr.descr: The diagram shows the steps in photolithography, beginning with step 1 at the top middle. Text to the right of (1) reads, “Program desired sequences.” Below there is a square with a smaller flat square inside it. This area is labeled “solid surface.” Within the solid surface are 4 wells, shown as flat white circles, and the sequences are shown being added to the wells. The wells are numbered 1-4, with 1 at the top left, 2 to the top right, 3 to the bottom left, and 4 to the bottom right. The sequences have each nitrogenous base color coded. C is red, A is blue, T is yellow, and G is green. Well 1 has CGTA added to it, vertically, as if in a chain. Well 2 has CCTG added to it; 3 has GGTA; 4 has GCCG. Down and left is step 2. Step 2 has the image of the solid surface with the wells from before being bathed in yellow light (labeled above). To the right, the 2 rightmost wells are labeled “photolabile blocking groups.” Wells 2 and 4 have been shaded gray, and there is a label below reading, “opaque screens over spots 2 and 4.” Each spot has a small red asterisk over it, attached to the well by a small black line. Down and right, there is a curved arrow with a divergent arrow showing the removal of 2 red asterisks off to the right; a convergent arrow is on the left, showing the addition of 5 blue As with red asterisks over them. Below this is step 3. It shows the flat solid surface from before with the gray screen over spots 2 and 4, but now the starred blue As are being added to spots 1 and 3. Spots 2 and 4 do not bond to the starred As. To the right is a repeat of step 2: the solid surface is bathed in yellow light (labeled above), but now there is gray shading over spots 1 and 3, which have the starred A. Spots 2 and 4 are left open. To the right is an arrow, then a repeat of step 3, in which 5 green Gs with red asterisks over them are added to the solid surface. To the upper right is a repeat of step 2, which shows the whole solid surface bathed in yellow light (labeled above) and spots 1, 2, and 3 shaded gray with the opaque screen (labeled left). Finally, a down and right arrow has a divergent left arrow showing the removal of the asterisks, and a convergent right arrow showing the addition of 5 red Cs with red asterisks over them. Below this the solid surface now has a red starred C binding to the green G at spot 4. A down arrow points to text reading, “Many more cycles.”
